items.name: neu-theme
items.title: Neu Theme
items.description: Neumorphic token foundation: surface-derived dual shadows, four shapes, trig light source, state and focus channels.

.neu-ground, .neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-co.--neu-text: color(from var(--neu-surface) srgb-linear calc(var(--_text-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_text-alpha)) * r) calc(var(--_text-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_text-alpha)) * g) calc(var(--_text-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_text-alpha)) * b))
.neu-ground, .neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-co.--neu-text-muted: color(from var(--neu-surface) srgb-linear calc(var(--_muted-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_muted-alpha)) * r) calc(var(--_muted-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_muted-alpha)) * g) calc(var(--_muted-alpha) * var(--_flip) + (1 - var(--_muted-alpha)) * b))
.neu-ground, .neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-co.--neu-ring: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) var(--_ring-l) calc(0.17 * min(1, (1 - var(--_ring-l)) * 4)) h)
.neu-ground, .neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-co.--neu-knob-ink: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) var(--_ink-l) calc(0.15 * min(1, (1 - var(--_ink-l)) * 4)) h)
.neu-ground, .neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-co.--neu-destructive: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) var(--_destructive-l) calc(0.2 * min(1, (1 - var(--_destructive-l)) * 4)) 25)

.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_dark: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l - var(--neu-shade-dark, var(--neu-shade)) * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6)) c h / var(--neu-alpha))
.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_light: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l + var(--neu-shade-light, var(--neu-shade)) * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6)) c h / var(--neu-alpha))
.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_drop: var(--neu-drop, oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l * 0.15) c h / min(1, var(--neu-alpha) * var(--neu-shade-dark, var(--neu-shade)) * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6) / max(l * 0.85, 0.01))))
.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_face-dark: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l - var(--neu-face)) c h)
.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_face-light: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l + var(--neu-face)) c h)
.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.--_glint: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) 0.97 c h / calc(clamp(0, (0.62 - l) * 3, 1) * 0.3 * var(--neu-glint) * min(1, var(--neu-alpha) * 1000)))

.neu, .neu-pressed, .neu-concave, .neu-c.box-shadow: var(--_x) var(--_y) var(--_blur) var(--_dark), calc(var(--_x) * -1) calc(var(--_y) * -1) var(--_blur) oklch(from var(--_light) l c h / calc(alpha * var(--neu-highlight))), inset var(--_gx) var(--_gy) 0 var(--_glint)

.neu-pressed.box-shadow: inset var(--_x) var(--_y) var(--_blur) var(--_dark), inset calc(var(--_x) * -1) calc(var(--_y) * -1) var(--_blur) var(--_light), inset calc(var(--_gx) * -1) calc(var(--_gy) * -1) 0 var(--_glint)

.neu-line, .neu-line-b, .neu-line-t.--_line-dark: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l - var(--neu-shade-dark, var(--neu-shade)) * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6)) c h / 0.7)
.neu-line, .neu-line-b, .neu-line-t.--_line-light: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l + var(--neu-shade-light, var(--neu-shade)) * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6)) c h / 0.3)

.neu-realism.box-shadow: calc(var(--_x) * 0.08) calc(var(--_y) * 0.08) calc(var(--_blur) * 0.06) calc(var(--_blur) * -0.03) oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.5)), calc(var(--_x) * 0.16) calc(var(--_y) * 0.16) calc(var(--_blur) * 0.12) calc(var(--_blur) * -0.05) oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.48)), calc(var(--_x) * 0.3) calc(var(--_y) * 0.3) calc(var(--_blur) * 0.24) calc(var(--_blur) * -0.08) oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.44)), calc(var(--_x) * 0.55) calc(var(--_y) * 0.55) calc(var(--_blur) * 0.46) calc(var(--_blur) * -0.1) oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.36)), var(--_x) var(--_y) var(--_blur) calc(var(--_blur) * -0.13) oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.18)), inset var(--_gx) var(--_gy) 0 oklch(from var(--_light) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.9)), inset calc(var(--_gx) * -1) calc(var(--_gy) * -1) 0 oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.5))

.neu-text-emboss.text-shadow: calc(var(--_x) * -1) calc(var(--_y) * -1) var(--_blur) var(--_light), var(--_x) var(--_y) var(--_blur) var(--_dark)

.neu-knob.background: linear-gradient(var(--neu-light-angle), oklch(from var(--_kf) calc(l - 0.03) c h), var(--_kf)) padding-box, linear-gradient(var(--neu-light-angle), oklch(from var(--_kf) calc(l - 0.09) c h), oklch(from var(--_kf) calc(l - 0.02) c h)) border-box

.neu-lift, .neu-lift-sm.box-shadow: calc(var(--_kx) * 0.3) calc(var(--_ky) * 0.3) calc(var(--_kblur) * 0.25) oklch(from var(--_drop) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.9)), var(--_kx) var(--_ky) var(--_kblur) var(--_drop)

.neu-cap, .neu-state-cap[data-state='on'.--_kb: var(--neu-knob, oklch(from var(--neu-surface) max(calc(l + 0.08), 0.84) calc(c * 0.5) h))
.neu-cap, .neu-state-cap[data-state='on'.background: linear-gradient(oklch(from var(--_kb) calc(l - 0.01) c h), oklch(from var(--_kb) calc(l - 0.035) c h)) padding-box, linear-gradient(calc(var(--neu-light-angle) - 180deg), oklch(from var(--_kb) calc(l + 0.04) c h), oklch(from var(--_kb) calc(l - 0.05) c h)) border-box

.neu-groove.background: oklch(from var(--neu-surface) calc(l - var(--neu-shade) * 0.45 * clamp(1, 1.9 - l * 1.5, 1.6)) c h)
.neu-groove.box-shadow: inset calc(var(--_lx) * var(--_u)) calc(var(--_ly) * var(--_u)) calc(var(--_u) * 2) 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25)

.neu-rise.transition: opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 280ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), filter 280ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)

.neu-glyph-lift.filter: drop-shadow(calc(var(--_ex) * 0.4) calc(var(--_ey) * 0.4) 0.4px oklch(from var(--_drop) l c h / max(calc(alpha * 1.2), 0.35))) drop-shadow(var(--_ex) var(--_ey) calc(var(--neu-distance) * var(--neu-depth) * 0.5) oklch(from var(--_drop) l c h / max(alpha, 0.18)))

.neu-engrave.box-shadow: inset calc(var(--_gx) * -1) calc(var(--_gy) * -1) 0 oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 1.1)), inset var(--_gx) var(--_gy) 0 oklch(from var(--_light) l c h / calc(alpha * 1.3)), inset calc(var(--_gx) * -2) calc(var(--_gy) * -2) 2px oklch(from var(--_dark) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.4)), inset calc(var(--_gx) * 2) calc(var(--_gy) * 2) 2px oklch(from var(--_light) l c h / calc(alpha * 0.5))

.neu-overlay.box-shadow: var(--_ox) var(--_oy) calc(var(--neu-blur) * var(--neu-depth) * 0.6) oklch(from var(--_drop) l c h / calc(alpha * 1.2))

.neu-overlay-scrim.box-shadow: calc(var(--_ox) * 1.5) calc(var(--_oy) * 1.5) calc(var(--neu-blur) * var(--neu-depth)) oklch(from var(--neu-surface) 0.12 c h / calc(var(--neu-alpha) * 0.7))

.neu-active-sink:active, .neu-state-sink.box-shadow: inset var(--_x) var(--_y) var(--_blur) var(--_dark), inset calc(var(--_x) * -1) calc(var(--_y) * -1) var(--_blur) var(--_light), inset calc(var(--_gx) * -1) calc(var(--_gy) * -1) 0 var(--_glint)

items.name: neu-button
items.title: Neu Button
items.description: Neumorphic button with the stock shadcn button API. Raised by default, sinks on press. Hover keeps its depth.

items.name: neu-card
items.title: Neu Card
items.description: Neumorphic card with the full shadcn card composition. Raised by default, plus a carved well variant.

items.name: neu-checkbox
items.title: Neu Checkbox
items.description: Neumorphic checkbox on the Radix primitive. A carved square well; checking lifts an accent tick off its floor.

items.name: neu-button-demo
items.title: Neu Button Demo
items.description: All neu button variants on a neumorphic ground.

items.name: neu-card-demo
items.title: Neu Card Demo
items.description: Raised and well neu cards side by side.

items.name: neu-checkbox-demo
items.title: Neu Checkbox Demo
items.description: Neu checkbox states including the always-visible ghost tick.

items.name: neu-input
items.title: Neu Input
items.description: Neumorphic input with the stock shadcn input API. A well carved into the surface.

items.name: neu-textarea
items.title: Neu Textarea
items.description: Neumorphic textarea with the stock shadcn textarea API. The same carved well as the input.

items.name: neu-select
items.title: Neu Select
items.description: Neumorphic select on the Radix primitive. A raised trigger that stays sunken while its popup is open.

items.name: neu-radio-group
items.title: Neu Radio Group
items.description: Neumorphic radio group on the Radix primitive. A carved well; checking raises an accent cap out of it.

items.name: neu-input-demo
items.title: Neu Input Demo
items.description: Neu input states: empty, filled, invalid and disabled wells.

items.name: neu-textarea-demo
items.title: Neu Textarea Demo
items.description: Neu textarea states on a neumorphic ground.

items.name: neu-select-demo
items.title: Neu Select Demo
items.description: Neu select with groups, sizes and a disabled trigger.

items.name: neu-radio-group-demo
items.title: Neu Radio Group Demo
items.description: Neu radio group with checked, unchecked and disabled holes.

items.name: neu-knob
items.title: Neu Knob
items.description: The shared raised handle behind the switch, slider, radio, toggle and active page.

items.name: neu-switch
items.title: Neu Switch
items.description: Neumorphic switch on the Radix primitive. A shallow track that fills with the accent when checked, and a raised knob that travels. Three sizes.

items.name: neu-slider
items.title: Neu Slider
items.description: Neumorphic slider on the Radix primitive. A carved groove filled with the accent up to the value, and a raised bead with an accent pip as the thumb.

items.name: neu-progress
items.title: Neu Progress
items.description: Neumorphic progress on the Radix primitive. The slider minus interaction: carved groove, raised accent rod.

items.name: neu-skeleton
items.title: Neu Skeleton
items.description: Neumorphic skeleton: a carved well with a travelling raised bar, shimmer derived from the surface token.

items.name: neu-switch-demo
items.title: Neu Switch Demo
items.description: Neu switch states and sizes on a neumorphic ground.

items.name: neu-slider-demo
items.title: Neu Slider Demo
items.description: Neu slider single, range, disabled and vertical.

items.name: neu-progress-demo
items.title: Neu Progress Demo
items.description: Neu progress at several values, one animating on mount.

items.name: neu-skeleton-demo
items.title: Neu Skeleton Demo
items.description: Neu skeleton in a small card mock.

items.name: neu-badge
items.title: Neu Badge
items.description: Neumorphic badge with the stock shadcn variant set. A small raised chip; secondary carves in, outline sits flat with a muted border.

items.name: neu-separator
items.title: Neu Separator
items.description: Neumorphic separator on the Radix primitive. An engraved line: a rounded two-stop gradient, dark crease over lit edge, derived from the surface token and thickened by Elevation.

items.name: neu-sliding-key
items.title: Neu Sliding Key
items.description: The shared sliding knob: a hook that measures the selected item in a carved tray and the raised knob that follows it. Used by the neu toggle group and tabs.

items.name: neu-tabs
items.title: Neu Tabs
items.description: Neumorphic tabs on the Radix primitive. The same carved tray as the toggle group: idle triggers sit flat and one raised knob slides to the active one. The line variant keeps the stock underline.

items.name: neu-dialog
items.title: Neu Dialog
items.description: Neumorphic dialog on the Radix primitive. A floating sheet that casts one shadow onto a surface-derived scrim.

items.name: neu-drawer
items.title: Neu Drawer
items.description: Neumorphic drawer on vaul. A floating sheet sliding in from the screen edge, with a carved grab handle and the surface-derived scrim.

items.name: neu-tooltip
items.title: Neu Tooltip
items.description: A neumorphic tooltip that floats above the surface with an elevation shadow.

items.name: neu-popover
items.title: Neu Popover
items.description: Neumorphic popover on the Radix primitive. A floating panel that re-grounds itself outside the page wrapper, with a plain elevation shadow.

items.name: neu-hover-card
items.title: Neu Hover Card
items.description: Neumorphic hover card on the Radix primitive. A floating preview panel with the same re-grounded overlay treatment as the popover.

items.name: neu-alert-dialog
items.title: Neu Alert Dialog
items.description: Neumorphic alert dialog on the Radix primitive. A floating sheet that casts one shadow onto a surface-derived scrim, actions as neu buttons.

items.name: neu-sheet
items.title: Neu Sheet
items.description: Neumorphic sheet on the Radix dialog primitive. A panel sliding in from the screen edge that becomes its own ground, over the surface-derived scrim.

items.name: neu-menu
items.title: Neu Menu
items.description: The shared surface, item, label and separator styles of the dropdown menu, context menu and menubar.

items.name: neu-dropdown-menu
items.title: Neu Dropdown Menu
items.description: Neumorphic dropdown menu on the Radix primitive. A floating clay panel with tinted item highlights.

items.name: neu-context-menu
items.title: Neu Context Menu
items.description: Neumorphic context menu on the Radix primitive. The same floating clay panel, summoned by right click.

items.name: neu-menubar
items.title: Neu Menubar
items.description: Neumorphic menubar on the Radix primitive. A raised bar of flat chips that sink while their menu is open.

items.name: neu-label
items.title: Neu Label
items.description: Label with the stock shadcn label API. Typography only, no depth of its own.

items.name: neu-form
items.title: Neu Form
items.description: React-hook-form wrapper with the stock shadcn form API. Field wiring plus neu text tokens for descriptions and errors.

items.name: neu-toggle
items.title: Neu Toggle
items.description: Neumorphic toggle on the Radix primitive. A raised key that is pressed into the surface and filled with the accent while on.

items.name: neu-toggle-group
items.title: Neu Toggle Group
items.description: Neumorphic toggle group on the Radix primitive. A carved well that follows the theme radius; in single mode one raised knob slides to the pressed item.

items.name: neu-input-otp
items.title: Neu Input OTP
items.description: Neumorphic one-time-password input. Each slot is its own carved well; the active slot carries the focus ring.

items.name: neu-alert
items.title: Neu Alert
items.description: Neumorphic alert with the stock shadcn structure. A raised surface like a card at tighter padding; destructive keeps the neu surface and alarms through text color only.

items.name: neu-avatar
items.title: Neu Avatar
items.description: Neumorphic avatar on the Radix primitive. A subtly raised circular rim at tight shadow scale; the fallback is a pressed circle with muted initials.

items.name: neu-accordion
items.title: Neu Accordion
items.description: Neumorphic accordion on the Radix primitive. Flat triggers with a tinted hover, groove borders between items, stock height animation untouched.

items.name: neu-collapsible
items.title: Neu Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible on the Radix primitive. Pure logic with data-slot attributes; styling belongs to the content you put inside.

items.name: neu-aspect-ratio
items.title: Neu Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect ratio on the Radix primitive. Pure logic with a data-slot attribute.

items.name: neu-scroll-area
items.title: Neu Scroll Area
items.description: Neumorphic scroll area on the Radix primitive. Stock structure with a soft rounded thumb tinted from the text token; focus is the outline ring.

items.name: neu-table
items.title: Neu Table
items.description: Neumorphic table. Flat rows on the ground with groove borders and a tinted hover; no card chrome, so it nests inside a card when raised framing is wanted.

items.name: neu-breadcrumb
items.title: Neu Breadcrumb
items.description: Neumorphic breadcrumb with the stock shadcn breadcrumb API. Flat muted text with the current page at full contrast.

items.name: neu-pagination
items.title: Neu Pagination
items.description: Neumorphic pagination with the stock shadcn pagination API, built on the button variants. Pages are ghost buttons and the current one is pressed into the surface; Previous and Next are raised keys that go flat at a dead end.

items.name: neu-navigation-menu
items.title: Neu Navigation Menu
items.description: Neumorphic navigation menu on the Radix primitive. A raised bar of flat chips that sink while their panel is open.

items.name: neu-carousel
items.title: Neu Carousel
items.description: Neumorphic carousel on embla. Stock embla mechanics; the arrows are round engraved keys from the neu button's outline variant, and they jump instead of scroll when reduced motion is on.

items.name: neu-resizable
items.title: Neu Resizable
items.description: Neumorphic resizable panels on react-resizable-panels. The handle is the engraved separator line with a small raised grip.

items.name: neu-sonner
items.title: Neu Sonner
items.description: Sonner toaster on the neu surface tokens. Toasts float over the page, so they keep sonner's elevation shadow.

items.name: neu-spinner
items.title: Neu Spinner
items.description: Loading spinner in the muted text tone. Size via className.

items.name: neu-command
items.title: Neu Command
items.description: Neumorphic command palette on cmdk with the stock shadcn command API. A raised panel with a sunken search well.

items.name: neu-calendar
items.title: Neu Calendar
items.description: Neumorphic calendar on react-day-picker with the stock shadcn calendar API. Flat day cells; the selected day and the ends of a range carve in with the accent fill.

items.name: neu-sidebar
items.title: Neu Sidebar
items.description: Neumorphic sidebar composed from the neu sheet, tooltip, input, separator, skeleton and button. The panel is its own ground; menu items are flat chips that tint on hover and sink, with an accent bar, when active.
